name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right general contractor for my home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for an established track record, clear licensing and insurance, and an owner or project lead who actively communicates on site. Checking third-party ratings, such as a Better Business Bureau accreditation, provides insight into their dispute resolution and professional standing. Ask how they balance hands-on work with sub-trades: companies where the contractor personally manages framing, drywall, and finish work while coordinating specialized trades often maintain tighter quality control on finishes. Be cautious of vague estimates that omit labor details or trade management responsibilities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for verified credentials, BBB standing, transparent quotes, positive local reviews, and an active on-site project lead who clearly explains their process.
